no: Let I be the incenter of triangle ABC. Let L_{B} be the line through I perpendiculat to AC, and let A_{B} = L_{B} ∩BC and B_{A} = L_{B} ∩BA. Define B_{C} and C_{A} cyclically, and define C_{B} and A_{C} cyclically. Let A' be the circumcenter of :g:`IA_{B}A_{C} << I A_B A_C >>`, and define B' and C' cyclically. The triangle A'B'C' is perspective to ABC, and the perspector is X_7100. (Angel Montesdeoca, June 11, 2016)
